sections.Profile:
The "Naples" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on August 20, 1957, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin. This machine features two flippers, two pop bumpers, four passive bumpers, two slingshots, and six kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1957
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
